label: Motion Verbs
description: A 20-question check on the motion-verb pair lessons.

questions.prompt: Which verb correctly fills the gap: «Сейчас я ___ в школу» (one trip, happening right now, on foot)?
questions.explain: Сейчас marks one trip in one direction now, so the determinate идти (иду) is required, as in «Сейчас я иду в школу.»

questions.prompt: Which verb fits: «Каждый день я ___ в школу» (a daily habit on foot)?
questions.explain: Каждый день signals a repeated habit, which selects the indeterminate ходить (хожу): «Каждый день я хожу в школу.»

questions.prompt: What does «Вчера мы ходили в кино.» imply?
options: We were walking toward the cinema and never arrived.
We go to the cinema every day.
We went to the cinema and came back — a completed round trip.
We will go to the cinema tomorrow.
questions.explain: Past indeterminate ходили describes a finished there-and-back trip: we went and returned.

questions.prompt: In «Сейчас я еду на работу.», what is the speaker doing?
options: Making one trip to work right now, by vehicle.
questions.explain: Determinate еду (ехать) with сейчас names one ride in one direction happening now.

questions.prompt: Which verb fits: «Каждое утро я ___ на метро» (a daily commute by vehicle)?
questions.explain: Каждое утро marks a habitual ride, selecting the indeterminate ездить (езжу): «Каждое утро я езжу на метро.»

questions.prompt: Идти/ходить versus ехать/ездить: what is the core difference between the two pairs?
questions.explain: Идти/ходить is movement on foot, while ехать/ездить is movement by vehicle.

questions.prompt: What does «Летом мы ездили на море.» describe?
options: A single ride to the sea still in progress.
A completed round trip to the sea and back.
A habit of driving to work daily.
An ability to drive to the sea.
questions.explain: Past indeterminate ездили expresses a finished journey to the sea and back.

questions.prompt: Which verb fits: «Смотри, он ___ к автобусу» (running toward the bus right now)?
questions.explain: One run in one direction in progress takes the determinate бежать (бежит): «Смотри, он бежит к автобусу.»

questions.prompt: Which verb fits: «Каждое утро я ___ в парке» (a daily jog)?
questions.explain: Каждое утро marks a habitual, multi-directional jog, selecting the indeterminate бегать (бегаю).

questions.prompt: Why is «бегает» used in «Моя дочь хорошо бегает и плавает.»?
options: It describes one run happening right now.
It describes a general ability or skill, not a single trip.
It marks a completed round trip.
questions.explain: Describing a general ability rather than one trip requires the indeterminate бегать (бегает).

questions.prompt: Which verb fits: «Сейчас я ___ в Москву» (one flight in progress now)?
questions.explain: Сейчас fixes one flight in one direction, so the determinate лететь (лечу) is used: «Сейчас я лечу в Москву.»

questions.prompt: Which verb fits: «Каждый месяц я ___ в Берлин» (regular, recurring flights)?
questions.explain: Каждый месяц signals habitual round-trip flights, selecting the indeterminate летать (летаю).

questions.prompt: What does «Летом мы летали в Турцию.» mean?
options: We flew to Turkey and back — a completed round trip.
We are flying to Turkey right now.
We fly to Turkey every summer as a job.
We will fly to Turkey next summer.
questions.explain: Past indeterminate летали expresses a finished flight to Turkey and back.

questions.prompt: In «Она всегда носит очки.», what does «носит» mean here?
options: She is carrying glasses somewhere right now.
She carried glasses there and back.
She wears glasses — a constant habit.
She is able to carry glasses.
questions.explain: Носить also means 'to wear'; with всегда it describes a constant habit of wearing glasses.

questions.prompt: Which verb fits: «Сейчас я ___ ребёнка на руках» (carrying the child right now, one direction)?
questions.explain: Сейчас pins one carrying act to this moment in one direction, selecting the determinate нести (несу).

questions.prompt: What does «водит» mean in «Мой брат хорошо водит машину.»?
options: He is leading someone to a car right now.
He knows how to drive a car — a general skill.
He drove the car there and back yesterday.
He is walking toward the car.
questions.explain: The idiom водить машину means 'to drive a car'; here the indeterminate водит states a general skill, not one trip.

questions.prompt: Which verb fits: «Сейчас я ___ собаку гулять» (taking the dog out right now, one outing)?
questions.explain: Сейчас pins the leading to this moment and one outing, selecting the determinate вести (веду).

questions.prompt: Which verb fits: «Я обычно ___ собаку в парк» (a repeated, regular habit)?
questions.explain: Обычно marks a repeated round-trip habit, selecting the indeterminate водить (вожу).

questions.prompt: In «Я плыву к тому берегу.», what is happening?
options: Swimming around generally as a pastime.
One directed swim toward one goal, in progress.
A completed round trip across the river.
questions.explain: Determinate плыву (плыть) with the goal к берегу names one directed swim in progress.

questions.prompt: Why is «плавать» used in «Моя сестра умеет хорошо плавать.»?
options: It marks one swim toward a single goal right now.
It is a completed past round trip.
It indicates swimming against the current.
It expresses a general ability, which always takes the indeterminate.
questions.explain: Ability with no single direction selects the indeterminate плавать, used here as the infinitive after умеет.
